messages:
Zoe (People Ops): Heads-up: new manager sign-off & delegation rules for this review cycle. Short thread with the must-dos and a tiny checklist.

Carl (Eng Manager): Quick Q: what's changed vs last cycle?

Zoe (People Ops): Three small changes: 1) explicit delegation record requirement, 2) timezone-aware handoff window, 3) stricter evidence filename validation. All aimed at fewer import errors and clearer audit trail.

Priyanka (EM): Delegation record requirement =?

Zoe (People Ops): If you delegate sign-off to another manager (temporary or peer), add a single-line delegation note in the packet comments: "delegated-to: <name> (reason)" and include the delegator's Slack mention as manager sign-off. The import pipeline will reject packets without delegation notes when delegated.

Hugo (IC): If my manager is out and another manager signs off, will that affect my eligibility?

Zoe (People Ops): No. Delegated sign-offs are equivalent to primary manager sign-off if properly recorded. We keep an audit log for transparency. Promotions still follow calibration outcomes, not who clicked sign-off.

Carl (Eng Manager): Timezone-aware handoff window? We have folks in APAC.

Zoe (People Ops): New rule: when you assign a reviewer in a different timezone, set a local-window field (e.g., "avail: 09:00-17:00 JST") in the packet. If not set, the system assumes UTC-8 and may auto-assign reminders at odd hours. This prevents 3am pings for APAC reviewers.

Priyanka (EM): What's the evidence filename rule? We had CSV mismatches last time.

Zoe (People Ops): Use exact pattern: <team>-<manager>-<employee>-evidence-YYYYMMDD.pdf or .zip. No spaces, lowercase. Example: infra-priyanka-hugo-evidence-20260322.pdf Import fails on typos; please pre-validate filenames before upload.

Notify-Bot: Reminder: sign-off deadline Fri 17:00 PT. Auto-email to managers 72h and 12h before.

Hugo (IC): If a manager delegates to a peer, does the peer need manager-level permission in Workday?

Zoe (People Ops): Good catch. Delegates must be in the manager role or have delegated-review permission. If not, People Ops will auto-create a temporary review permission after approval email from the primary manager. Include that approval in the packet comments.

Carl (Eng Manager): Any changes to audits/retention? We used to have 90 days of edit history.

Zoe (People Ops): Audit retention extended to 180 days for this cycle (trial) to support appeals and rapid troubleshooting. The audit log shows who uploaded what and the delegation note.

Priyanka (EM): How do we handle last-minute manager swaps <24h before sign-off? That caused chaos before.

Zoe (People Ops): If swap <24h before sign-off, it becomes a manual process: file the in-thread quick-swap note and tag @people-ops. We'll fast-track and may grant a short 12-48h extension depending on coverage. Avoid last-minute swaps unless urgent.

Hugo (IC): For managers who are remote and offline, can we pre-authorize a delegate for the whole team?

Zoe (People Ops): Yes. Use the delegation form: https://rwd.in/delegate-review and put the delegation note in each packet. We recommend only one delegate per team to avoid conflicting sign-offs.

Carl (Eng Manager): Thanks. I'll add the filename checks to our checklist and set delegates for APAC leads.

Zoe (People Ops): Thanks folks 44d If anyone wants a 10-minute walkthrough of the delegation UI, I'll run a drop-in Wed 09:00 PT.
